history.summary: THIN RECORD - identity provisional. Directory listings (Justdial, meta.ai POI) confirm a 'Surya Temple' exists at Barkagaon, Hazaribagh district (PIN 825311), and a 2021 Garhwa Post report described a Surya Temple under construction by the Barkagaon Mandir Committee receiving a Rs 5.51 lakh donation from social activist Guru Pandey - which may or may not be the same shrine. No dedicated temple page, history, festivals or hours found in any web source. Image search returned only unrelated Surya temples (Ranchi, Handiya, Deo) - media left empty. CSV state error: CSV column holds town 'Hazaribagh'; actual state is Jharkhand. Coordinates are the unverified meta.ai POI listing (23.856578, 85.210404) - treat as approximate.

name: Surya Temple, Barkagaon
town_description: Barkagaon is a block town in Hazaribagh district, Jharkhand, about 15-18 km west of Hazaribagh city on the Hazaribagh-Tandwa road (PIN 825311). A small commercial centre for nearby villages, it sits in a coal-mining belt with basic markets, hotels and local transport links to Hazaribagh.

travel.airport: Birsa Munda Airport, Ranchi, about 100-110 km.
travel.railway: Hazaribagh Town railway station, about 18-20 km.
travel.road: On the Hazaribagh-Tandwa road; buses and autos from Hazaribagh city.

visitor_information.opening_hours: Not documented in any source - verify locally.
